common_psf.method: cross-convolve F475W by the nominal circular F814W Moffat and F814W by the nominal circular F475W Moffat
common_psf.variance_propagation: convolve input variance by the squared cross-convolution kernel

lens_colour_model.basis: F814W surface brightness multiplied by circular piecewise-linear radial hat functions plus constant and linear x/y sky terms
lens_colour_model.weighted_solver: linear least squares using propagated F475W plus current colour-scaled F814W variance
lens_colour_model.clip_rule: after each fit, exclude positive residuals above 3 sigma and either-sign residuals above 6 sigma; never add excluded pixels back

detection.noise_inflation: maximum of one and 1.4826 times the MAD of matched-filter S/N in negative/control annular pixels after excluding absolute values above 4
mask_variants: one-pixel erosion of the frozen mask

negative_control.construction: rotate the frozen arc mask by 90 degrees about the fixed half-pixel center, remove overlap with the arc mask, then add nearest available same-radius pixels in increasing absolute angular offset from the rotated locations until equal area

pre_rank_radial_support.interpretation: This is only support for attempting a four-column Jacobian; it is not a rank measurement.

visit_controls.difference_degrees_of_freedom: number of frozen arc pixels after fitting one relative scale and one sky offset

concrete_outcomes.advance: The >=5-sigma connected arc mask passes size, component, azimuthal-span, equal-area negative-control, at least three knot-neighborhood, and both-visit consistency gates.
concrete_outcomes.fail: If any gate fails, do not hand-edit the mask or lower thresholds. Retain E325 as an acquired control and replace it unless a separately frozen instrument-systematics test explains a specific failure without using a lens model.
